title: Petra: The City Carved Into Pink Rock
description: The Nabataean capital in today's Jordan, around the 1st century.

scenes.narration: This entire building is carved straight into a cliff.
scenes.image_prompt: the Treasury of Petra carved into pink sandstone cliff, sunlight

scenes.narration: It's the first century, in Petra, in today's Jordan. This is the capital of the Nabataeans.
scenes.image_prompt: bustling ancient Petra city with tombs carved into rock and people in robes

scenes.narration: They grow rich from trade: incense, spices and silk moving across the desert.
scenes.image_prompt: camel caravan carrying spices and incense through a desert canyon

scenes.narration: You enter through the Siq, a narrow canyon more than a kilometre long.
scenes.image_prompt: narrow winding sandstone canyon with towering walls, travellers on camels

scenes.narration: Then, the Treasury appears, glowing pink in the sunlight.
scenes.image_prompt: first glimpse of the Treasury through the narrow canyon opening, glowing pink

scenes.narration: Clever dams and channels collect rare rainwater for thousands of people.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient water channel carved along a sandstone canyon wall, flowing water

scenes.narration: Rome takes over in 106 CE, and trade routes slowly move away.
scenes.image_prompt: Roman soldiers marching into Petra with colonnaded street

scenes.narration: The outside world forgot about Petra for centuries. Where should we travel next?
scenes.image_prompt: Petra Monastery at sunset, a lone traveller
